title: Interpretable machine learning models for predicting the antitumor effects of metal and metal oxide nanomaterials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17036-17048
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02309B, Paper

Youfu Ma, Yu Jiang, Houlin Su, Jiajia Lei, Wenguang Xiao, Haijun Tian, Yawei Ma, Li Zhu, Yuxi Liang, Lisheng Wang, Mingqing Yuan, Xu Liu
Understanding the toxicity of metal and metal oxide nanoparticles (M/MOx NPs) is key to cancer diagnosis and therapy, yet generalization is hindered by limited data, sampling bias, hidden complexities, low model accuracy, and poor interpretability.
